content.value_statement: Teams need clear steps for reliable browser testing. This skill guides Playwright setup, test design, visual checks, browser coverage, and CI integration.
actual_capabilities: Outlines phases for setting up Playwright test projects.
Guides E2E test strategy, scenarios, fixtures, and page objects.
Covers browser automation tasks such as screenshots, traces, and mobile emulation.
Includes visual regression planning with baselines, assertions, and thresholds.
Describes cross-browser testing and CI integration quality gates.
limitations: Does not include executable test code or project-specific selectors.
Requires separate Playwright installation and environment configuration.
References related skills that may not be installed in every workspace.
Needs project-specific validation before tests are trusted in CI.

use_cases.title: Start a New E2E Suite
use_cases.description: Plan the first Playwright setup, test directory, browser configuration, and base test structure.

use_cases.title: Improve Release Confidence
use_cases.description: Map critical user flows, assertions, visual checks, and quality gates before a release.

use_cases.title: Prepare Tests for CI
use_cases.description: Design parallel execution, artifacts, reports, notifications, and cross-browser coverage for automated pipelines.

prompt_templates.title: Create a Basic Plan
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner setup for a new web application.
prompt_templates.prompt: Set up a basic Playwright E2E testing plan for my web application. Include project setup, first critical flow, and success criteria.

prompt_templates.title: Design Test Coverage
prompt_templates.scenario: Intermediate planning for core product flows.
prompt_templates.prompt: Design an E2E test strategy for login, checkout, and account settings. Include fixtures, page objects, and stable assertions.

prompt_templates.title: Add Visual and Browser Checks
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced expansion of an existing test suite.
prompt_templates.prompt: Expand my Playwright suite for visual regression and cross-browser coverage. Include baseline handling, browser matrix, and review steps.

prompt_templates.title: Integrate Tests with CI
prompt_templates.prompt: Prepare CI integration for my Playwright E2E suite. Include parallel execution, artifacts, reports, and failure triage.

output_examples.input: A user asks for a first E2E test plan for a new SaaS dashboard.
output: Recommended setup steps for Playwright and browsers.
Critical user flows to test first.
Quality gates for passing tests and stable results.

output_examples.input: A user wants visual regression added to an existing test suite.
output: A plan for comparing visual changes in CI.

output_examples.input: A user wants browser tests to run in CI for several browsers.

best_practices: Start with critical user flows before broad page coverage.
Use stable selectors and explicit assertions for reliable browser tests.
Keep screenshots, traces, and reports available for failure triage.
anti_patterns: Do not treat generated plans as proof that tests pass.
Do not automate visual tests without baseline review ownership.
Do not run broad browser matrices before core flows are stable.

faq.question: Does this skill write complete Playwright tests?
faq.answer: It provides workflow guidance and planning prompts. Project-specific code still needs implementation and review.

faq.question: Can it help with visual regression testing?
faq.answer: Yes. It covers baselines, visual assertions, thresholds, review steps, and related quality gates.

faq.question: Does it support multiple browsers?
faq.answer: Yes. It includes planning for Chromium, Firefox, WebKit, mobile browser checks, and result comparison.

faq.question: Can it prepare CI integration?
faq.answer: Yes. It guides workflow setup, parallel execution, artifacts, reports, and notifications.

faq.question: What tools does it assume?
faq.answer: It is centered on Playwright and references related testing, browser automation, and CI workflow skills.

faq.question: Is environment validation still required?
faq.answer: Yes. You must validate selectors, test data, browser settings, and CI permissions in your project.
